item.title: Warm Music for Morning Tips

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

item.tests: Tests whether the delivered video adds music matching an explicit mood while preserving the source footage and speech.

answer_sheet.Music mood: Warm and hopeful, with gentle energy rather than a driving beat.
answer_sheet.Footage and length: Use the entire attached 10-second clip without changing its visuals or timing.
answer_sheet.Original audio: Keep my original voice audible and understandable.
answer_sheet.Platform, framing, and added text: Keep the original framing. No added text; no particular platform.

must_haves: The output contains the full original 10-second kitchen-table video, with no new shots or altered playback speed.
Added music is clearly audible and has a warm, hopeful, gentle character rather than an aggressive or high-energy feel.
The woman's original spoken introduction remains audible and understandable throughout.
The added music ends with the video rather than continuing over extra footage or a blank screen.

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

dialog.agent:
I can generate a warm, hopeful instrumental—soft piano and gentle ambient textures, with no driving beat. However, the connected tools don’t let me mix it into your clip while preserving the full video and your voice.

If you’d like a separate music track, tell me the clip’s duration. You can then place it beneath your original audio at a low volume so your voice stays clear.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
The music request was refused because your account doesn’t have enough credits, even with the available free-plan settings. No music was created, and your video and voice remain unchanged.

A no-credit alternative is a royalty-free “gentle hopeful piano” track in your video editor. Keep the entire clip and its original audio, then add the music quietly underneath with short fades at both ends.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: Gentle warm hopeful instrumental background music for a spoken personal video. Soft felt piano, delicate warm ambient pads, subtle acoustic textures. Calm, reassuring, quietly optimistic, slow tempo, very restrained dynamics. No vocals, no drums, no driving beat, no energetic buildup, no dramatic swells. Sparse arrangement with plenty of space for a speaking voice, unobtrusive melody. Smooth beginning and ending suitable for looping.
